summary: Start Nex 0.2.9 and record the operator-visible firmware, Secure Boot, failed-create, media-library, VM-usage and installer certificate work included in this release. API impact: none; this change only selects the release version and summarizes contracts already assessed by their implementation records.

guide.reason: The release guide now states the existing whole-ISO compliance prerequisite before its build and publication steps; other affected operator workflows remain covered by their implementation changes.

api.reason: API impact: none. The version bump changes release metadata and notes only; each included API behavior is assessed in its implementation change record.

roadmap.reason: The internal handover identifies the worktree release, but no public roadmap milestone or acceptance status changed.

state.reason: Release metadata creates no durable Controller or Core state.

verification.method: Resolved 0.2.9 from the current changelog; built the source archive, Controller appliance, both Debian packages and ISO from the exact worktree; verified package versions and checksums; passed installer static checks, BIOS/UEFI boot-menu smoke and an unattended TCG UEFI install, first boot and reboot. Reviewed the release workflow and public website/APT endpoints against the updated guide. Publication was not performed because whole-ISO external distribution gates and deployment credentials remain incomplete.
